## Où j'en suis
The user wanted vendor IDs from the 'Vendors' sheet pulled into 'Oct AP' column D. XLOOKUP returned "not found" for about half the rows because of invisible characters. A helper column in Vendors (TRIM plus SUBSTITUTE of CHAR(160)) fixed most of them. Three rows still don't match because the names differ, and the user will fix them by hand. The top-row freeze question was answered too.

- [prochaine-étape] Fix the 3 unmatched vendor names by hand, e.g. 'Northpeak Talent Inc.' vs 'Northpeak Talent' and 'AWS Marketplace' vs 'Amazon Web Services'.
- [essai-raté] TRIM on whole columns (TRIM(Vendors!A:A)) inside XLOOKUP gave #VALUE; the helper column replaced it.
- [décision] Skip the alias table and correct the mismatched names by hand. (source: t09)
